gloss: (good) target; the right thing/time/place to aim for; a sweet spot or good opportunity

definitions.gloss: (good) target; sweet spot; the option, timing, or place that is the smart choice to aim for
definitions.explanation: The point at which something is most worth aiming for — the sweet spot in an opportunity, a wise choice, or a strategically good time or place. {狙|ねら}い{目|め} combines {狙|ねら}い ("aim") with {目|め} (here in its abstract "point, spot" sense, as in {境|さかい}{目|め} "boundary point" or {見|み}せ{場|ば}). It is a common everyday word in shopping, travel, dieting, investing, and exam-strategy contexts: "the smart move," "the angle to play," "the right time to go."

examples.japanese: {平日|へいじつ}の{昼|ひる}が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}だ。
examples.english: Weekday afternoons are the sweet spot.

examples.japanese: セール{初日|しょにち}が{一番|いちばん}の{狙|ねら}い{目|め}。
examples.english: The first day of the sale is the prime time to aim for.

examples.japanese: {観光地|かんこうち}は{混雑|こんざつ}を{避|さ}けたいなら、{早朝|そうちょう}が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}だ。
examples.english: For tourist spots, if you want to avoid the crowds, early morning is the time to aim for.

examples.japanese: {中古|ちゅうこ}{車|しゃ}を{安|やす}く{買|か}いたい{人|ひと}にとっては、{新車|しんしゃ}の{モデル}{チェンジ}{直後|ちょくご}が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}と{言|い}われている。
examples.english: For people who want to buy a used car cheaply, the time just after a new-car model change is said to be the sweet spot.

notes:
{狙|ねら}い{目|め} is an everyday noun meaning "the smart spot to aim for" — the timing, option, or place that offers the best opportunity. It is widely used in shopping, travel, exam-taking, dieting, and investing contexts.

FORMATION:
- {狙|ねら}い ("aim, target") + {目|め} (here in the abstract sense of "point, spot, angle") → "a point worth aiming for"
- The {目|め} here is the same suffix found in {境|さかい}{目|め} ("boundary point"), {結|む}び{目|め} ("knot point"), {見栄|みば}え ("appearance")

TYPICAL CONTEXTS:
- Shopping: "X is the smart deal" — セール{初日|しょにち}が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}
- Travel: "X is the best time/place" — {早朝|そうちょう}が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}
- Real estate: "X areas are the buying opportunity" — {駅|えき}{近|ちか}{物件|ぶっけん}が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}
- Exams: "X questions are the angle to attack" — {過去|かこ}{問|もん}{頻出|ひんしゅつ}の{単元|たんげん}が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}
- Job hunting: "X industries / companies are the play" — {中堅|ちゅうけん}{企業|きぎょう}が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}
- Investing: "X stocks are the opportunity" — {成長|せいちょう}{株|かぶ}が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}

GRAMMATICAL BEHAVIOR:
- Most commonly as a predicate: 〜が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}だ ("~ is the sweet spot")
- Modifier: 〜の{狙|ねら}い{目|め} ("the sweet spot of ~")
- Asking question: {狙|ねら}い{目|め}はどこ? / いつ? ("Where / when is the sweet spot?")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {狙|ねら}い{目|め}は〜だ: the sweet spot is ~
- {狙|ねら}い{目|め}を{探|さが}す: to look for the sweet spot
- {狙|ねら}い{目|め}を{見|み}{つ}ける: to find the sweet spot
- {一番|いちばん}の{狙|ねら}い{目|め}: the best sweet spot, the prime opportunity
- {買|か}い{時|どき}の{狙|ねら}い{目|め}: the sweet spot for when to buy
- 〜が{狙|ねら}い{目|め}: ~ is the sweet spot/the right play

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- {買|か}い{時|どき}: the right time to buy — specific to purchasing decisions
- {穴場|あなば}: hidden gem, lesser-known good spot — emphasizes secrecy / uncrowdedness
- チャンス: chance, opportunity (loanword) — broader and more neutral
- {好機|こうき}: good opportunity (formal/written)
- ベスト({タイミング|たいみんぐ}): the best timing
- {見|み}{所|どころ}: a point worth seeing, the highlight — different sense (something worth watching)
- {目|め}{星|ぼし}: a guess, a target one has in mind — related compound with {目|め}

USAGE NOTES:
- {狙|ねら}い{目|め} carries a slightly strategic, savvy connotation — the speaker is suggesting that they have analyzed the situation and identified the smart angle.
- It is common in lifestyle and consumer journalism ("5 watches that are the sweet spot for first-time buyers") and in conversation about shopping, travel, and timing.
- Pronunciation: {ねらいめ} (four morae). The verb {狙|ねら}う means "to aim, target."
